themes.name: Light
themes.note: The light theme for outdoors (the account menu: Dark / Light / System). Each colour and shadow token carries its light value in "light"; tests/design/build.py writes them into og.css as :root[data-theme="light"]. The dark look stays the default.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground under the blobs; the base of every screen. Deep and soft.

tokens.name: blob-indigo
tokens.usage: Ground blob, drawn soft: about 30–42% strength over a wide 52–55% fade. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: blob-cyan
tokens.usage: Ground blob, drawn soft: about 30–42% strength over a wide 52–55% fade. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: blob-pink
tokens.usage: Ground blob, drawn soft: about 30–42% strength over a wide 52–55% fade. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Flat app background where no blobs are drawn (tables, long forms).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised flat surface: inputs, flat menus.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover state on flat surfaces.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Plate solid fill under its gradient (plate-top → plate-bottom): what text contrast is measured on, and the tick tile fill.

tokens.name: plate-top
tokens.usage: Plate and window gradient, its light corner (top left of a plate, top of a window) — owner 2026-10-22, style 3e with 3b shading.

tokens.name: plate-bottom
tokens.usage: Plate and window gradient, its dark end (bottom right of a plate, from 60% down a window).

tokens.name: plate-on
tokens.usage: A selected plate in Select mode.

tokens.name: tick-on
tokens.usage: A checked tick tile.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass button and glass bar fill (with backdrop blur 12px).

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: The one primary glass button on a screen; active tab pill is glass-active.

tokens.name: glass-active
tokens.usage: Active tab pill.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of glass buttons and glass popovers.

tokens.name: glass-menu
tokens.usage: Popover, Undo snack and Select bar fill (with backdrop blur 16px).

tokens.name: glass-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet fill (with backdrop blur 18px).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside menus and sheets.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on glass and on the blobs; plate names.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: plate sublines, labels, mono figures, idle ⋮. 7.0:1 on plate (brightened by the V7 readability change, 2026-10-17).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Empty tick box border and disabled marks only, never text (fails 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-glass
tokens.usage: Section labels and hints on the blob ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The app accent: links, the blue plate bar, info.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: OK: active worker bar, checked tick box, approved.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Attention: missing documents, vacation, pending.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Problem: expired visa, delete action fill (at 22% alpha).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Delete text and icon on glass (8.9:1 on glass-menu).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Default avatar disc; per-person avatars use muted mid tones.

tokens.name: uline-1
tokens.usage: Animated underline gradient, stop 1 (indigo).

tokens.name: uline-2
tokens.usage: Animated underline gradient, stop 2 (cyan).

tokens.name: uline-3
tokens.usage: Animated underline gradient, stop 3 (pink).

tokens.name: tick-mark
tokens.usage: The drawn check stroke inside a green box.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Screen title, with its count after it in ink-2 at 14px.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Figures on top of a list (stats).

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, ticks, menu items (menu items 500).

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section label with its count on the right.

styles.name: mono-figure
styles.usage: Hours and amounts at the right of a plate.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between plates; gap between ticks and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Avatar to text on a plate; header gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding; plate left padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section top margin; sheet side padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Row ⋮ button, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tabs, tick tiles, swipe action buttons (12).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass buttons, plates, popovers, snack.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatar discs.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, snack, select bar.

tokens.name: shadow-uline
tokens.usage: Glow of the animated underline.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Plates and window sections: a line of light on the top edge and a soft shadow under them (after the status bar).
